title: A team of Gemini 4 Argon agents beats Minecraft
abstract: arXiv:2610.22319v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We placed four Gemini 4 Argon agents in a sandboxed Minecraft survival world and gave them one goal: defeat the Ender Dragon. Each agent controlled a player via an open-source library called Mineflayer and coordinated with its teammates through in-game chat and shared memory. No one assigned roles or wrote game logic. The agents planned, wrote, and debugged every program themselves. Researchers could watch the run on a live dashboard and pause or stop it at any time, but they had no cause to intervene. Starting from a randomly generated world on Easy difficulty, the team wrote 2,783 programs and defeated the dragon in 27 hours and 14 minutes, dying 605 times along the way. To our knowledge, this is the first end-to-end autonomous completion of Minecraft by AI agents, achieved using only the standard Mineflayer library without pre-scouted seeds or other game-specific tools written by humans. translated_title: 一个由四名Gemini 4 Argon智能体组成的团队击败了《我的世界》（Minecraft）
translated_abstract: 我们将四个Gemini 4 Argon智能体置于一个沙盒化的《我的世界》生存世界中，并给它们设定了一个目标：击败末影龙。每个智能体通过名为Mineflayer的开源库控制一名玩家，并通过游戏内聊天和共享记忆与队友进行协调。没有任何人为它们分配角色或编写游戏逻辑，所有程序均由智能体自行规划、编写和调试。研究人员可以通过实时仪表板观看运行过程，并可随时暂停或停止，但他们没有理由进行干预。从一个随机生成的简单（Easy）难度世界开始，这支团队共编写了2,783个程序，在27小时14分钟内击败了末影龙，期间共死亡605次。据我们所知，这是AI智能体首次端到端自主完成《我的世界》游戏，且仅使用了标准的Mineflayer库，没有借助预先勘探的种子或任何由人类编写的游戏专用工具。获胜需要智能体保持连贯的……
tldr: 四个Gemini 4 Argon智能体在无任何人类编写游戏逻辑或专用工具辅助下，完全自主协作、自行编写并调试2,783个程序，在27小时14分钟内首次实现AI端到端击败《我的世界》末影龙。
en_tdlr: A team of four Gemini 4 Argon agents achieved the first end-to-end autonomous completion of Minecraft, defeating the Ender Dragon in 27 hours and 14 minutes by self-writing and debugging 2,783 programs without any human-written game logic or game-specific tools.
